name: livingruntime-remote
description: Bounded SSH-backed remote development tools for LivingRuntime hosts, with local stdio and ChatGPT Secure MCP Tunnel transports.

interface.shortDescription: Operate LivingRuntime hosts over bounded SSH.
interface.longDescription: Windows user-level remote development plugin. Use list_projects, then connection_status, read_file, git, and logs against named projects such as virtualbrain and ferro. Codex and ChatGPT Desktop Work use local stdio. Public listing is a later track.
defaultPrompt: Use LivingRuntime Remote connection_status to verify the host, then show repository status with git.
Read the current service logs with logs and inspect the matching source file with read_file.
